_comment: Bounded engine knobs for this channel (the engine reads these). scenes.allowed = which of [1 full-face, 2 glide-right, 3 glide-left] the picker may use; scenes.glide = left|right|either; animations.banned = pack names never to use. Editorial judgment (mostly-face, when to split, etc.) lives in guidelines.md, not here. Laws are never knobs.
